assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 活动带涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 活动客流、报名与社会化数据仅作概念性匿名聚合引用，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Event-traffic and social data are concept-level anonymized references only, not official statistics.

assumptions.statement_zh: 京张论坛广场、代码坞与回路长廊设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 活动人流热力与会务指引仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Event heat-mapping and wayfinding process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI开发者大会、开源共创周与京张创新节等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement: Existing green-space, tree maturity, station value, building-use efficiency and station-interface conditions are pending inputs; no current-state claim is made.
assumptions.verification_trigger: Official GIS/CAD, heritage, ownership and field survey package is supplied.
assumptions.impact: Recalculate siting, quantities, maintenance and narrative labels before physical deployment.

assumptions.statement: 24 land-use zones and 24 land-use features are the same conceptual GeoJSON feature count, not statutory parcel count.
assumptions.impact: Update all bilingual outputs with old/new deltas.

assumptions.statement: Roles, annual cadence, costs and KPIs in O01-O06 are proposals; no institution, budget or partner is confirmed.
assumptions.verification_trigger: Responsible organizations and pilot agreements are confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Do not launch an AI scenario until decision-gate prerequisites are met.
